page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance sits primarily in the lower tiers for compute and memory tasks. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show weak read performance, though large-block write operations achieve average tier results. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as gzip and bzip3, register in the bottom 10% to 25% of benchmarks. However, the CPU demonstrates average performance in Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests, alongside average prompt processing and text generation speeds for small 135M parameter language models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2.xlarge offers a dedicated hardware profile without the premium cost of high-performance compute or memory-optimized architectures. Given its balanced resource density but lower benchmark scores, it is best suited for general-purpose workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation but do not demand high-throughput processing. Appropriate workloads include basic web serving, lightweight database operations, small-scale application hosting, and running small language model inference tasks where execution speed is not critical.
